html:
Every year, when summer comes, Trang An – Tam Coc puts on a brilliant yellow coat. To admire that beauty, let’s take a walk around Trang An – Tam Coc and admire the beauty of the ripe rice season with Vietlook Travel.

Trang An – Tam Coc is not only known for its natural cultural heritage, but it also offers visitors unique festivals and delicious dishes that seem to hold the travelers’ footsteps.

Traveling to Trang An – Tam Coc, visitors will be amazed by the beauty of the majestic natural landscape of the mountains. Each season, Trang An brings visitors a different beauty, but the most beautiful is still Trang An – Tam Coc in the ripe rice season.

Especially when sitting on the boats gliding on the Sao Khe River, admiring the beauty of the Trang An scenic area in a brilliant golden season, surrounded by towering rocky mountains, below is the clear blue water, and the golden rice fields create a beautiful picture, an indispensable destination when going on a Ninh Binh tour.

Currently, Trang An – Tam Coc is a destination chosen by many domestic and international tourists, a stopover during every vacation or weekend, because this place not only has beautiful scenery but also brings peace, if you are someone who does not like the noise of the city, Trang An – Tam Coc is the destination for you.

The best time to travel to Trang An – Tam Coc is from January to March, at this time the cool spring weather is very suitable for tourists to visit and enjoy the scenery. In particular, this is also the occasion when Trang An holds many exciting festivals, in which the festival that attracts the most attention from tourists is the peace-praying festival at Bai Dinh Pagoda.

Traveling to Trang An from April to June, tourists can immerse themselves in the immense lotus season, tourists can rent long dresses to take pictures next to the fragrant lotus season of Trang An.

Traveling to Trang An – Tam Coc from May to August, this is the season of golden ripe rice, tourists can take a boat to admire the beauty of the golden season, at this time the weather is quite sunny so tourists can also save beautiful pictures.

In addition, Trang An scenic area also has check-in points for tourists to record beautiful pictures when traveling to Ninh Binh, in which the most prominent is the Kong film studio, a virtual living place chosen by many tourists.

Traveling to Trang An from August to October, visitors will immerse themselves in the autumn weather, at this time the weather is cool and less rainy, very suitable for a vacation in Trang An.

Traveling to Trang An from October to December, there are rains at this time, so it will not be convenient for visitors to visit and enjoy the scenery, or check in for beautiful photos.

In addition, Trang An – Tam Coc is also a resort that many tourists seek out, this is not only a place with a peaceful landscape but also has many luxurious resorts, designed very close to nature, so many tourists choose Ninh Binh as their resort during each vacation.

So if you are planning to travel to Trang An – Tam Coc Ripe Rice Season, let’s pack your backpack and go with Vietlook Travel today, to visit and enjoy the scenery that nature has bestowed upon this place.
